change: Same experiment as E014_hu_wide (fixed HU window [-1000, 1000] at slicing, ENet 8/2, CE, seed 123, 25 epochs, 15/5 split) on a 4-organ ground truth: the archive's GT class 1 is esophagus UNION aorta, and retrieve_aorta.py splits it into esophagus (1) + aorta (4) with a distance-transform watershed gated on four plausibility criteria. K is still 5 (class 4 was empty before), so the architecture and the output dimension are unchanged. The only difference against E014_hu_wide is the target.
hypothesis: The aorta is a large, high-contrast, contiguous structure: once it has a class of its own the model should segment it well (Dice well above 0.8), and the split must not cost the other organs - heart and trachea labels are voxel-identical to SEGTHOR_huwide, so their Dice should reproduce E014_hu_wide (0.885 / 0.653) within seed noise. Esophagus Dice cannot be compared against E014_hu_wide: the target is now the thin organ alone (AORTA_INSPECTION: 7092 voxels on Patient_07 instead of 115229 folded), not the fold.
plan_reference: AORTA_INSPECTION/aorta-findings.md; full_plan.md section 3 (aorta) superseded for a recoverable label

dataset.name: SEGTHOR_aorta_huwide
dataset.source: segthor_part1 (GT class 1 split back into esophagus + aorta)
dataset.label_caveat: Derived, not annotated: the split is validated by Dice 0.9994/0.9980 against the single reference patient (Patient_07 GT2) and by four geometric gates plus visual review on the other 19.

selection_metric.interpretation: No configured class is empty any more, so the model-selection mean and the mean over classes that actually hold labels now agree: the E014-era inflation of +0.0456 is gone by construction.

comparison_to_parent.note: E014_hu_wide's stitched volumes scored against the SAME 4-organ GT, so the protocol is identical and only the training target differs.
comparison_to_parent.heart_trachea_control: heart 0.900 vs 0.885 and trachea 0.664 vs 0.653 - identical labels, so the gap is seed/protocol noise, not a label artefact. Sanity check: E014_hu_wide scored on this GT reproduces its folded-GT heart/trachea numbers exactly (0.885 / 0.653).
comparison_to_parent.interpretation: Giving the aorta a class of its own costs nothing on the other organs and turns class 4 from 0.000 into 0.667. The esophagus 'drop' against the folded number (0.673 -> 0.229) is the target changing, not a regression: the fold's class 1 was 115229 voxels on Patient_07 while the thin esophagus is 25373.

notes: Failure mode on the thin esophagus: the model systematically under-segments it - predicted/GT volume ratio 0.15 (P01), 0.23 (P11), 0.36 (P15), 0.60 (P17), 0.50 (P19).

Patient_15 is the worst case on both organs: esophagus Dice 0.000 (3388 predicted voxels, zero overlap with the 9459-voxel target) and aorta 0.537 (106736 predicted against 250470 - the model captures only 43% of what is the widest aorta of the 20 patients, median axial area 1384 mm^2). Under-segmentation, not a wrong location.
Labels are derived, not annotated: Dice 0.9994 aorta / 0.9980 esophagus against the single reference patient (Patient_07 GT2); the other 19 rest on four geometric gates plus visual review.
Heart and trachea are comparable with every earlier run; esophagus is comparable only with other runs on data/SEGTHOR_aorta.
Run locally on MPS under the hub supervisor; an earlier attempt was killed by a tool deadline mid-epoch-2 and restarted from scratch (train.interrupted.log is that stale log).

what_to_check: Aorta 3D Dice: no longer n/a in metrics3d.py. A large contiguous vessel should land well above 0.8; below 0.6 means the label is wrong somewhere.
Heart and trachea 3D Dice against E014_hu_wide (0.885 / 0.653): identical labels and identical protocol, so any gap beyond seed noise is a bug.
Esophagus 3D Dice is not comparable with E014_hu_wide. Check it against the thin-organ target instead: the validation slices hold 405 esophagus slices (was 582 for the fold).
Val-slice presence: class 4 must be present in 508/915 validation slices; dice_val.npy class 4 must not be a constant 1.0 (that was the phantom-class failure mode on the folded data).
check_labels.py --dice_npy on the run: 'main.py:321 mean' and 'mean over classes with GT' must now agree, because no configured class is empty.
